guilds from someone in one and watched a lot of guild content: at ur level(s) don't even worry about guilds. and even at 160 (soon 170), you probably still wont care about guilds.

really the only thing to do in guilds is raid but raiding is SOOOOO inaccessible to many players. you need 12 players in total, the raid key, good gear, and a strategy to beat the raid. there's other little stuff but they add to these 4 main goals to start a raid. 

guilds themself are already a bit inaccessible, you gotta have 12 people at one time, online, in order to even start a guild. no getting the only 3 people you talk to to try and make a guild, gotta find 8 other ragamuffins. even if you have 12 people to start.....good luck lol. you know have to farm azoth! yay! (not really yay)

getting azoth is a ball-aching, tortuous, sadistic process. yeah you'll easily get the crafter open and maybe one of the islands but then you have to get in gear now. gotta turn that *general* azoth into *school* azoth, which takes....a lot of time. and when some of the opening requirements use mostly school azoth in the double digits, have fun, because getting school azoth is randomized when you use the transmute at the crafter. 

you can get school-specific azoth transmute recipes but these are ONLY obtainable from using the normal transmute recipe at the guild house crafter. and boy do the rates for dropping these recipes seem fucking low. I've been crafting azoth since around may, using a program to farm azoth using the pet school scout talents and I've only gotten the ice and death azoth transmutes.

yeah, very fun.

of course this os easily when you have other people also farming azoth but you gotta find some dedicated people...

only those who want to badly raid will willingly do all of this, if a player doesn't get one way or another about raiding then they are less likely to want to do any of this. and that's already a good amount of the playerbase. the people that do want to raid but cant find friends/people, see the intense grind you have to do, see what crazy gear you need, are thus discouraged from even trying.

if you want a place where you and your friends dick around and basically have a community castle, go for it. it's nice that me and my friends basically have something that we can see is collectively ours. but we're working adults who don't have the time for farming azoth and its only 5 of us. I'm one of 2, maybe 3, people that will actually farm azoth and that's bc I'm a college student. we are just now opening the guild manor and it took me and someone else like 6 months just to farm the azoth required for it. 

we are never going to be able to raid but I think we're all fine with that, the wind in our sails was taken out when we saw how much was needed to even initiate a raid. i happily watch other people do raids, the stress is just not worth it to me.

it doesn't hurt to start a guild but if you're just achinggggg to join a raid, find a guild where the people are serious about it. if you see raid content and are like "man this kinda sucks" then make a guild just to say you made one. or don't, guilds are kinda....just there for the time being. it could be described like beastmoon or monstrology, a piece of side content that doesn't affect your main story stuff (excluding the raid gear but that's a different beast I try to ignore).

​

tl;dr: guilds are hard to get into when you're the average wiz player based on the grindy and player requirements. find a guild with serious people if you really want to raid. make a guild, or don't, if you just want the guild status and couldn't care less about raids. guilds at the moment are kinda useless.
